testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle visibility from the solid bodies folder: tmp/obk-body-visibility-Gi8hyJ/source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:407:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle visibility from the solid bodies folder ✔ Given an active part in the MCAD Software contains one visible solid block ✔ And the Solid Bodies folder is visible in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the Solid Bodies folder ✔ Then its context menu offers Visibility, Expand All Children and collapses All Children ✔ And Visibility is checked ✔ When the user chooses Visibility ✔ Then the shaded block is hidden and its body remains listed in the browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the Solid Bodies folder again ✔ Then Visibility is unchecked ✔ When the user chooses Visibility again ✔ Then the shaded block returns in the same apparent view
